2. **Confirm authorization.** If you are part of the internal programming or legal review team and have been granted specific clearance to work with this material, please provide that authorization context. I can then re-evaluate whether the task falls within the permitted scope.
3. **Use cleared material.** If there is a post-embargo or already-public version of these notes, share that file and I'll produce the full comparative summary immediately.

I'm ready to help as soon as the embargo status or authorization is clarified.
